jobs.title: Managing Director, Daanish Schools Authority (DSA), Ministry of Federal Education & Professional Training
jobs.organization: Ministry of Federal Education and Professional Training
jobs.description:
Qualification: Minimum Master’s degree from an HEC-recognized national or foreign university. Preference shall be given to candidates possessing a Master’s degree in Finance, Public Administration, Business Administration, Management Sciences, Economics or Social Sciences.
Experience: At least 17 years of professional experience in public or private sectors, including at least two (02) years’ experience in educational organizations or institutions in a senior management position.
Job Type: Contract (03 years)
Duty Station Islamabad, with frequent travel to Daanish Schools and project sites across Pakistan
Purpose of the Post
The Managing Director is the chief executive of the Daanish Schools Authority and is responsible for providing strategic, academic, administrative and financial leadership to the Authority. The MD shall ensure that the Daanish Schools system delivers high-quality, free residential education to talented children from underprivileged and less-developed areas, expands the network in line with the Federal Government's vision (including the hub model in Balochistan, Sindh and the Merged Districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa), and is managed with transparency, value for money and full compliance with the applicable laws, rules and regulations.
Major Job Descriptions (Key Result Areas)
3.1 Strategic Leadership and Vision
Formulate and implement the DSA strategic plan, annual work plans and long-term expansion roadmap with Board approval.
Translate Federal Government education priorities into measurable DSA targets and programmes.
Lead the institutional development of DSA as a newly established Authority, including its structure, systems and culture.
3.2 Academic Excellence and School Operations
Ensure high academic standards, admission on merit, and holistic student development (character, sports, co-curricular and life skills).
Oversee the admission process, including the admission test conducted through FBISE or another designated body.
Introduce modern pedagogy, STEAM, digital learning and AI-enabled personalised learning in Daanish Schools.
Ensure safe, healthy and child-protective residential (boarding) environments.
3.3 Expansion and Development Projects
Lead the establishment of new Daanish Schools and hubs, including site selection, PC-I/PC-II preparation and approval through the planning forums.
Monitor construction, furnishing and operationalisation of new campuses within approved cost and time.
